thread:
carter: FYI P1 from WavePay — customers seeing elevated timeouts (embeddings route) on Dedicated us-west-2. CS escalated at ~15:04 UTC. Error spike ~12%.
maya: I'm on it. Checking pool3 metrics and routing. Can someone @devon or @lena confirm if autoscale or quota tripped?
devon: On it. Not seeing autoscale events in the control plane, but gpu-7 reported a series of IO errors around 15:03. Downloading node logs now.
ops-bot: Deploy 5023 -> pool3 rolled out at 15:01 UTC (canary 5%).
lena: I can own a short-term mitigation: route WavePay to fallback `small-model-quant` when seq_len < 512. Need a router rule pushed. @maya can you approve fallback strategy?
maya: Approved for fallback. Keep it conservative — 80/20 safety split first to avoid saturating the fallback.
devon: Pushing router rule CL: `router/rules/2026-03-17/wavepay-fallback`. Rolling to 10% now, will observe then 50%.
carter: CS has given customer a 30m mitigation window. Please confirm we can hit that.
devon: Rollout started at 15:10 UTC to 10%. Monitoring p50/p99 and token failures. If stable in 10m, proceed to 50%.
maya: If errors persist we will rollback canary 5023. @ops-bot please prepare rollback commands and timings.
ops-bot: Rollback playbook created: `runbook/rollback_5023.md` (https://redwood/ops/runbook/rollback_5023) :white_check_mark:
lena: After stabilization we should investigate KV cache evictions and potential kernel OOMs on gpu-7. Proposing eng-runtime (maya + devon) own RCA and timeline for a permanent fix.
carter: Good. I'll update the customer after the 50% milestone or sooner if we see improvement. Please drop short notes into the incident doc.
devon: 15:20 UTC — progressed to 50%, error rate back to baseline. Continuing to monitor for 1h. If stable, recommend closing P1 and opening a follow-up ticket for root cause.
maya: Adding follow-up tickets and action items to the tracking board (ENG-ops backlog). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
_notes: thread focuses on cross-team coordination, ownership, rapid mitigation rollout, and SLA communication. kept concise slack style with mentions and bot messages
